book_page_offset_rule: book_page = pdf_page - 10 (PDF pages 17–76 correspond to book pages 7–66)

excluded_pages_in_range.reason: Blank separator page at the end of Chapter 1 containing only running header ('36 1 • Statements') and footer ('Access for free at openstax.org').

excluded_front_matter_pages: PDF pages 1–16 (Cover, Title, Copyright, Table of Contents, and Preface)
page_counting_rule: Count 1-indexed physical PDF pages within the selected range [17, 76] that contain substantive textbook content after Unicode normalization (NFC) and stripping running headers/footers. Exclude cover, TOC, preface (pages 1–16), blank page 46 (only 49 chars of running header/footer), and chapters 3–14 (pages 77–397).

character_count_summary.note: Exact character count measured across 59 valid pages after NFC normalization and header/footer stripping (blank page 46 excluded); logged in results/metrics_summary.json.

metadata_schema.book_page: int — textbook page number printed in header (page - 10)
metadata_schema.chapter: string — 'ch1_statements' for PDF pages 17–45, 'ch2_expressions' for PDF pages 47–76 (used for metadata filtering in Strategy C)
metadata_schema.section: string — section identifier detected from page headings (e.g. '1.1', '1.2', ..., '2.9')
